title: Home practical guide and safety card: shadow investigation
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 22 (Home practical guide and safety card: shadow investigation (portal worksheet; never shine torches into eyes))
intro: Lesson 22: Investigation: torch distance and shadow size. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how torch distance changes shadow size
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Put the object 20 cm from the wall
Shine the torch at it from 100 cm; never into eyes
Measure the height of the shadow
Move the torch to 80, 60, 40 and 20 cm and measure each time
Keep the object in the same place

questions.q: Big question: how could you make your hand's shadow giant?
questions.a: Move your hand closer to the light.
